describes: Anthropic Admin API GET /v1/organizations/usage_report/messages response saved as JSON (bucket_width=1d or 1h, group_by[]=model). Token quantities only: no money.

sources.covers: data[].starting_at/ending_at (RFC 3339), results[].uncached_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens, cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens, output_tokens, model (null unless group_by model), api_key_id, workspace_id, service_tier; bucket_width 1d|1h|1m

provenance.notes: uncached_input_tokens excludes cache reads and cache writes, which are reported separately: the same convention as the OTK ledger (input = uncached input). Use group_by[]=model, otherwise model is null and every line is UNKNOWN.

timestamps.note: RFC 3339 values carry their offset (Z); no declaration needed.
